old: If $S$ is heated, its resistance rises, so the null point shifts towards $S$, giving a larger $l$ measured from the $R$ end.
new: If $S$ is heated, its resistance rises, so $l$ (measured from the $R$ end) decreases and the null point shifts towards $R$.
fixes: Heating S makes the null point shift towards R (l decreases), not towards S

old: Shunting $S$ with a resistor reduces it, so the null point shifts towards $R$.
new: Shunting $S$ reduces its resistance, so $l$ increases and the null point shifts towards $S$.
fixes: Shunting S makes the null point shift towards S (l increases), not towards R
